name: my-instrument
notes: Copy this file to instruments/<slug>.json. Drums: type 'drums', fill 'lanes' (lane name -> MIDI note) and 'fallbacks'. Melodic: set range, articulation_mode (none | velocity | keyswitch | keyswitch+velocity), keyswitch notes and/or velocity bands. latching=true means one keyswitch note at each articulation change; false means the keyswitch is held for every note it applies to. Synths: cc_map (automation param -> CC), pitch_bend_range, legato_overlap (beats glide notes overlap). Groove players (type 'phrase'): phrase_keys {part: [keys]} and part_map {section name: part}.
